events.title: Happy Next Fest!
events.summary: Hello, fellow gamers! I’m Omega-Ariston, the creator of the indie game Cap 'n Barr's Adventure. Steam Next Fest is finally here. Thank you for your continued support. Seeing so many friends from around the world enjoy this game fills us with relief and gratitude. Development has been intense since the Demo launched. events.title: Cap 'n Barr's Adventure Demo Officially Released!
events.summary: Hello, fellow gamers!I’m Omega-Ariston, the creator of the indie game Cap 'n Barr's Adventure.It’s been a full year since we officially started development! On this special occasion, we have finally released the Demo version! 🎉We are also very happy to announce that our team has welcomed a new member—the game-loving music producer Funkey has officially joined! events.title: A Letter to Fellow Gamers
events.summary: Hello, fellow gamers! I’m Omega-Ariston, the creator of the indie game *Cap 'n Barr's Adventure*.
